name: plate-51-sleeve-revB-std
version_tag: STANDARD-SPEED VARIANT of plate-51 — QUIET block stripped (outer wall 60->200, travel 180->500, accel 2500->10000) on Ron's 'print it standard speed'. Kept alongside the QUIET original rather than replacing it: this is a fit-critical flanged sleeve and outer-wall speed is the setting that moves a bore. | #159 SLEEVE REV B, SOLO — Ron, bench: 'the 23h goes slightly beneath the satellite.' Root cause is a DESIGN HOLE in #149: the drive stack had no axial seat. The sleeve slid down the post until it sat on the fixture base at z2.5, dropping every arm 2.5mm — the 23h arm ran at ~9.2-10.0, under the month strike tips (11.70-12.50) and into the mesh lamina zone. The 24h arm's tall 4mm band kept the daily train alive, which is why the video looked healthy while the strike train was low. Rev B adds a FLANGE FOOT: r13 disc from 2.5 to 5.0 standing on the fixture base, seating the bottom piece at exactly z5.0. Flange clears the board tooth sweep (r31.6 from the drive axis) and sits under the 24h band. Round r4.17 bore throughout (the wheel is the crank); square 11.50 key from 5.0 up. REPLACES the plate-48 sleeve - the old one is scrap. Solo plate so Ron's bench gets the fix in ~20 min without waiting for plate-50. Dab of grease under the flange if the thrust face sings. | QUIET.
